newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht firmer late, interbank steady.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht firmer late, interbank steady.

text.p: The Thai baht firmed slightly against the dollar in late trade on Friday.
Dealers said baht/dollar was tracking choppy dollar/yen trade. The Japanese currency regained some ground late after a rising dollar briefly broke 120 yen earlier, dealers said.
Bidding sentiment firmed towards the baht in late trade at 25.797-25.817 baht per dollar, dealers said. The baht had traded at 25.800-25.803 per dollar on Friday morning.
Dealers described trade as moderate and choppy.
The overnight interbank market was steady at 10.00-10.50 percent, unchanged from earlier.
The interbank market was quiet but liquidity is expected to tighten next week as the dollar is seen posting further gains in the foreign exchange market.

"The market was very quiet today and unaffected by the currency, but next week I think the rate will rise as the dollar gains and some money is withdrawn before Chinese New Year," said a dealer at Bangkok Bank.
The range on the one-month baht/dollar swap premium widened late to 9.00/10.00 against 9.10/9.70 earlier.
